text.p: FBL Financial Group Inc said Friday it purchased 965,370 shares, or five percent of its Class A common stock as part of a previously announced share repurchase program.
The company on March 20 reported its board had authorized a repurchase of up to one million shares of Class A common, to be limited to certain property-casualty companies owning shares of FBL.
The shares were purchased at $25.725 per share, the average closing prices over the prior 10 days of NYSE trading.

FBL said the purchase asnd cancellation of the shares will not reduce the number of shares in the public float. As a result of the repurchase, the company's outstanding common stock decreased to 17.9 million shares. The remaining 34,630 shares are available for repurchase during 1997 at the request of qualified stockholders, FBL said.
FBL, a holding company, underwrites, markets and distributes life insurance, annuities, property-casualty insurance and mutual funds.
